rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for responsible travel to natural areas that supports the environment and local communities.

example.english: We’re going on an ecotourism trip in the countryside this weekend and supporting local shops along the way.
example.traditional: 我哋今個周末去郊外玩生態旅遊，順便幫下當地小店。
